about: The topic tree of this toolkit. Every toolkit module lives at <Division>/<topic path>/<File>.lean, where the topic path is one listed below. Mirrors Mathlib's top level. Add a topic only by deciding a `new_topic` item of a promotion or gardening checklist.

topics.scope: algebraic identities and structures not specific to a field below
finite sums and products: rearrangement, double counting, telescoping
inequalities in ordered rings and fields
real and functional analysis not specific to a field below
derivatives, Taylor expansions, mean value arguments
convex sets and functions, Jensen-type inequalities
normed and inner-product spaces, operator bounds
exp, log, powers, Gamma and similar functions
finite combinatorics not specific to a field below
counting arguments: binomial and multinomial coefficients, partitions of finite sets
permutations and their actions on finite structures
randomized designs and design-based inference
vector spaces and linear maps
matrices: traces, determinants, positive definiteness, decompositions
measures and measurable functions not specific to a field below
integration: integrability, interchange of limits and integrals
optimization not specific to a field below
convex optimization: duality, subgradients
optimality conditions: first and second order, KKT
orders and lattices
probability not specific to a field below
concentration and tail inequalities
conditional probability and conditional expectation
named distributions and their properties
independence and exchangeability
laws of large numbers, central limit theorems, convergence in distribution
expectations, variances, covariances and higher moments
mathematical statistics not specific to a field below
asymptotic theory of estimators and tests
estimators: unbiasedness, efficiency, consistency
sampling from finite populations
hypothesis tests, p-values, confidence sets
topology and convergence
